name: Bangalore Cube Fest D 2024

venue.name: Janma Wellness Club
venue.address: Janma Wellness Club, Ganesha complex, RBI Layout Main Rd, Eswara Layout, JP Nagar 7th Phase, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560076

information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BangaloreCubeFestD2024#42639-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Only one guest per participant is allowed owing to space constraints in the venue.
